crossRefs.note: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells…
and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for Yahweh’s sake.
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord…
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and…
Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for…
Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made…
You call on the name of your god, and I will call on Yahweh’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All…
They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until…
When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and…
At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near, and said, “Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and…
Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart…
Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
